svg.title: The world map's layers
svg.desc: The world map as Isaac leaves Vale, as the player sees it, tilted into perspective, comes apart into the three sheets the console stacks to draw it, then closes again. From the back: the lower ground on BG3, with the grass and the paths; the upper ground on BG2, with the mountains, woods and cliffs; and the sprites in front, Isaac and the places on the map, among them Vale. Both ground layers are tilted one screen line at a time and share a priority, so BG2, the lower-numbered, is drawn in front, and the sprites in front of both. Where the upper ground covers it, the lower ground is left unfinished.
svg.text: THE WORLD MAP, AS THE PLAYER SEES IT
